title: feat: Complete ROADMAP — C.5 Production Hardening, WCAG audit, responsive stories, visual regression
body:
Implements all remaining code-deliverable ROADMAP items. After this, only business/infra items remain unchecked (marketplace website, Cloud platform, partner ecosystem).

### C.5 Production Hardening

- **CSP meta tag** in `apps/console/index.html` — `default-src 'self'`, no `unsafe-eval`, documented `unsafe-inline` requirement for Tailwind/Radix
- **Modulepreload plugin** in `vite.config.ts` — `preloadCriticalChunks()` injects `<link rel="modulepreload">` for `vendor-react`, `framework`, `ui-components`, `vendor-radix` chunks at build time
- **Cache-Control docs** — `apps/console/docs/deployment.md` with Nginx, Caddy, Vercel, AWS configs and chunk architecture reference
- **Error tracking guide** — `apps/console/docs/error-tracking.md` covering Sentry integration and lightweight custom alternative
- **Performance budget CI** — `.github/workflows/performance-budget.yml` fails build if main entry > 60 KB gzip, posts results to PR

### 1.2 WCAG 2.1 AA Audit

- `wcag-audit.test.tsx` — 30 axe-core tests covering all UI primitives (Accordion through Tooltip) and custom components (Spinner, Empty, Kbd)
- Fixed `Slider` to forward `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` to Radix `Thumb` (was a real WCAG violation the audit caught)

```tsx
// Before: aria-label on Root doesn't reach the thumb (role="slider")
<SliderPrimitive.Thumb className="..." />

// After: ARIA props forwarded to the interactive element
<SliderPrimitive.Thumb aria-label={ariaLabel} aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy} className="..." />
```

### 1.3 Responsive Storybook Stories

- `ResponsiveGrid.stories.tsx` — 7 stories (1→2→3 col, dashboard layout, gap variants)
- `AppShell.stories.tsx` — 2 stories (responsive dashboard with sidebar, minimal shell)

### 1.4 Visual Regression Tests

- Extended `.storybook/test-runner.cjs` with `postVisit` DOM snapshot capture (opt-in via `STORYBOOK_VISUAL_REGRESSION=true`)
- Added `storybook:test:snapshot` / `storybook:test:snapshot:update` scripts
- `.github/workflows/visual-regression.yml` CI workflow on component/field/layout changes

### ROADMAP

All 8 items checked off. C.5 section marked complete. Plugin dev guide already existed (`create-plugin` + `plugins.md`), marked accordingly.
